recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If a future current build reintroduces an R3/R4 maps page, re-evaluate or copy the R4B limitation from the published R4B page then; no current core-source change is needed for FHIR-36796.
issue_request: FHIR-36796 was a Published FHIR-core R4B change request for FHIR-core-r3maps. It asked to update the R3/R4 maps page for R4B changes; the final Not Persuasive with Modification resolution said not to update the maps themselves, but to document interversion mapping limitations because R4B either did not change existing resources or changed low-use resources radically.
initial_application: The R4B branch commit 670aa69262 added an R4B note to source/r3maps.html explaining that the transforms are R3/R4, not R4/R4B, and that R4-to-R4B conversions are not offered. The published R4B r3maps page contains that note, so the requested R4B publication change was applied.
additional_context: The current build no longer publishes r3maps.html: build.fhir.org/r3maps.html returns 404, while source/hierarchy.xml and source/documentation.html expose r4maps.html as the active transforms page. The active r4maps page already says maps are not authoritative, cover resources in R4 or R4B, and point to the conversion registry. Community searches found no conflicting Zulip evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source file was edited because restoring R4B-specific text to the dormant current-source r3maps.html would not affect the current built specification, and the R4B publication already carries the limitation text requested by the issue.
